issues.message: Home dashboard list can grow to 50 dashboards (Q02) but has no search or filters, violating P08 which requires a browse list that can grow to have search/filters. Fix: Add search by dashboard name (FD03) to F05 home flow, or add a separate browse flow with search, or add a justified assumption that search is deferred and list pagination limits growth.

Skipped entries for (user, Dashboard, act) and (user, Widget, act) reuse pairs that already have act flows (F09 and F13-F19); a pair must have flows or a skip, not both. Fix: Remove the two skipped act entries; document out-of-scope publish/share/export/undo/template acts in assumptions/outOfScope instead, keeping only pairs with no flow in skipped.

F12 and F17 both claim to edit Counter label (FD08), creating two flows for the same goal and violating P13/P14 one goal per flow. Fix: Keep Counter label editing in only one flow: remove FD08 from F12 description (leave it in F17) or vice versa, so each field/goal is owned by a single flow.

Assumption A17 says no search/filter in MVP but F05 implements Search (FD14) and describes filtering dashboards by name. Fix: Make them consistent: either remove Search FD14 from F05 and keep A17, or update A17 to state home list includes search by name (FD14) to satisfy the editor must-have browse/search expectation and P08.

Home flow adds search/filter by name (FD14) that scope inScope does not include and that new assumption A17 says MVP has no search/filter. Fix: Remove Search (FD14) from F05 description and fields, or add search to inScope and update A17 to allow filtering; keep catalog consistent.

Checklist checked state is a boolean but defined as singleChoice with options checked/unchecked instead of boolean type. Fix: Change FD10 type to boolean (or keep singleChoice but justify) and ensure example and options match the type.
Form FM06 Checklist item form is defined but no flow description references it by id. Fix: Reference FM06 in F18 description where checklist item text is entered, or remove the unused form.

Flow name promises title and settings but description only edits title and explicitly defers all type-specific settings to F17-F19. Fix: Rename F12 to title-only or expand its description to edit the type-specific settings it claims to cover with correct field ids.

Assumption A17 says no search/filter in MVP but F05 implements Search (FD14) and describes filtering dashboards by name. Fix: Make them consistent: either remove Search FD14 from F05 and keep A17, or update A17 to state home list includes search by name (FD14) to satisfy the editor must-have browse/search expectation and P08.
